task_definitions.title: Create Environment Configuration Template
task_definitions.description: Create a .env.example file that documents all required environment variables for the Notion integration setup

task_definitions.title: Enhance README Documentation
task_definitions.description: Expand the README.md to include comprehensive project documentation: setup instructions, usage examples, API documentation, and troubleshooting guide
acceptance_criteria: API function documentation for createTask and updateTask

task_definitions.title: Implement Input Validation Module
task_definitions.description: Create a validation module to validate inputs for createTask and updateTask functions, ensuring data integrity before API calls
acceptance_criteria: Validation function checks title is non-empty string
Status validation ensures valid Notion status values
Clear error messages for invalid inputs
Validation module is testable and reusable

task_definitions.title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
task_definitions.description: Enhance error handling throughout the application with specific error types, better error messages, and graceful failure modes
acceptance_criteria: Custom error classes for different failure types
Notion API errors properly caught and logged
Network errors handled with clear messages

task_definitions.title: Add Retry Mechanism for API Calls
task_definitions.description: Implement automatic retry logic for transient API failures with exponential backoff to improve reliability
acceptance_criteria: Retry logic with configurable max attempts
Only retry on transient errors (5xx, network issues)
Do not retry on 4xx client errors

required_research: Notion API rate limits and retry best practices

task_definitions.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functionality
task_definitions.description: Add functions to query and retrieve tasks from the Notion database by ID, status, or other criteria
acceptance_criteria: Function to get task by page ID
Function to query tasks by status
Function to list all tasks with pagination
Error handling for not found scenarios

task_definitions.title: Implement Task Deletion Functionality
task_definitions.description: Add capability to archive or delete tasks from the Notion database
acceptance_criteria: Function to archive task by page ID
Proper error handling for non-existent tasks

task_definitions.title: Fix Assigned To Field Implementation
task_definitions.description: Resolve the ambiguity in the 'Assigned To' field by properly implementing people array handling or adjusting to use a select/text field
acceptance_criteria: Assigned To field properly populates in Notion
Clear documentation on how to use assignedTo parameter
Support for Notion user IDs or decide on alternative approach

task_definitions.title: Implement Logging Framework
task_definitions.description: Replace console.log with a proper logging framework that supports different log levels and optional file output
acceptance_criteria: Support for log levels: debug, info, warn, error

task_definitions.title: Implement Batch Operations Support
task_definitions.description: Add functionality to create or update multiple tasks in a single operation for improved efficiency
acceptance_criteria: Function to create multiple tasks from array
Function to batch update task statuses
Proper error handling for partial failures
Return detailed results for each operation

task_definitions.title: Create CLI Interface
task_definitions.description: Build a command-line interface to allow direct interaction with the task manager without modifying code
acceptance_criteria: CLI commands for create, update, get, list, delete
Executable via npm scripts or npx

task_definitions.title: Create Unit Test Suite
task_definitions.description: Implement comprehensive unit tests for all functions using a testing framework
acceptance_criteria: Tests for createTask function with mocked Notion API

task_definitions.title: Create Integration Test Suite
task_definitions.description: Develop integration tests that verify end-to-end functionality with actual or mock Notion API
acceptance_criteria: Tests for complete task lifecycle (create, update, retrieve, delete)
Test database configuration separate from production

task_definitions.title: Add Type Definitions
task_definitions.description: Create TypeScript type definitions or JSDoc comments for better IDE support and code documentation
acceptance_criteria: JSDoc comments for all exported functions
Custom types defined for Task objects

task_definitions.title: Implement Configuration Management
task_definitions.description: Create a configuration module to manage settings beyond environment variables, such as retry counts, timeouts, and default values

task_definitions.title: Add CI/CD Pipeline Configuration
task_definitions.description: Set up continuous integration and deployment pipeline for automated testing and quality checks
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions or similar CI configuration

task_definitions.title: Add ESLint and Prettier Configuration
task_definitions.description: Configure code linting and formatting tools to maintain code quality and consistency
acceptance_criteria: npm scripts for lint and format commands

task_definitions.title: Refactor Main Function to Examples
task_definitions.description: Move the main() demo function to a separate examples directory to keep the main module clean

task_definitions.title: Add Rate Limiting Awareness
task_definitions.description: Implement rate limiting awareness to respect Notion API limits and prevent throttling

task_definitions.title: Create Contributing Guidelines
task_definitions.description: Document contribution guidelines for potential collaborators
